svg.title: DIA-406 · Tasting From Your Own Pot
svg.desc: Five open vessels stand on one ground line beside a staff marked from zero to one hundred. Each is filled with water, drawn as fine wobbling lines, to a comprehension quiz score. Two wide vessels show the randomized trial: engineers who worked without AI, filled to 67, and engineers who worked with AI, filled in rust to 50. A dashed line carries the level of 67 across the plate. Three narrower vessels sort the AI users by habit: those who generated code and then made sure they understood it stand above that line at 86, those who handed the whole job over at 39, and those who had the AI debug for them at 24. The habit groups were observed, not assigned, with two to four engineers each.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 6 · THE COOK TASTES FROM HIS OWN POT
THE TRIAL: GROUPS ASSIGNED BY CHANCE
A comprehension quiz, scored out of one hundred.
THE AI USERS, SORTED BY HABIT
Observed, not assigned. A pattern, not proof.
Depth is the score, on one staff. 52 mostly junior engineers, in a randomized trial run by researchers at Anthropic, an AI vendor.
DIA-406 · With AI, engineers scored 50% on comprehension against 67% without. By habit the score ran from 24 to 86.
